newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Road King signs loan for new projects.
newsitem.headline: Road King signs loan for new projects.

text.p: Road King Infrastructure has signed a US$138 million loan to be used for investment in new projects, the company said in a statement on Thursday.
Road King concentrates on investing in, managing and operating toll-road projects in China.
The five-year syndicated amortizing loan has a grace period of three years.
The loan was underwritten by Peregrine Fixed Income.
Twenty-three banks participated in the transaction, Road King said.
In addition to Peregrine, Development Bank of Singapore, Bank of China Hong Kong branch, Hanwha Merchant Bank, Industrial Bank of Korea and Bank International Ningbo acted as lead managers, it said.
Road King said that since its listing on the Hong Kong stock exchange in July 1996, it has increased the number of its toll road projects to 16 from 10.
